summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Note Conversion Agreements with two existing investors, converting $750,000 in principal and accrued interest of unsecured convertible notes into 1,891,388 shares of common stock at $0.4401 per share (the June 5, 2026 closing bid price). The notes had matured on March 13, 2026. The conversion is automatic and occurred on June 8, 2026, with shares issued promptly. Registration rights are granted, requiring a resale registration statement by September 4, 2026. This is a routine debt-to-equity conversion by existing holders, not a capital-raise event or special situation. No external transaction, premium, or strategic shift is involved. There is no risk-arb angle.
